reviews.title: Disgusting experience with worst airline
reviews.text: This is the worst airline I’ve ever dealt with. I have been trapped in Malaysia for three days due to them having 1 - a delayed flight, 2 - refusing to check on anyone with a suitcase onto the next flight due to check in being closed as we were delayed, 3 - refusing to book us another flight to newzeland. They will only take me as far as Australia as their next flight to NZ is in 2 WEEKS?! So I have had to pay for an Australian visa and wait in the airport for it to be approved then buy another flight to NZ. And now they refuse to take me to gold coast only Melbourne WHY?! The staff are horrible and just don’t care. I’m truly disgusted at this experience. I’ve probably lost up to £600 due to their mistakes.
reviews.author: Caroline M

reviews.title: Bad Experience
reviews.text: I booked flight BKK-SYD on 14 October for a flight on 10th January, however they cancelled flight on 18 November and offered an unacceptable alternative flight 1 week later that would mean i would miss the event i was travelling for. No one to speak to just an automated BOT. I cancelled flight and asked for a refund on 18 Nov. They have agreed to refund but still a work in process some 4 months later. Very frustrating because there appears no way to contact them apart from a useless chat BOT. They take the money straight away and when they cancel they do not refund after 4 months. They are using my money which leads me to question the financial ethics and stability. BUYER BEWARE
reviews.author: rickuk56

reviews.title: Cancellation
reviews.text: Ha ha. Flight was booked to conclude a cruise. Onward arrangements made, return to work date organised, cats to be collected from Cattery.... Flight changed to 5 days later, no explanation. Text message only, received whilst at sea, no roaming service, service only when at port. 2 children involved.
reviews.author: Clwclm

reviews.title: Charging for water on a 9+!hour flight
reviews.text: Worst airline ever, even worse then ryanair and that's saying something. On a flight from Sydney to Kuala Lumpur taking over 8 and a half Hours and was delayed for over an hour. You have to pay for everything even water. On a flight that long free water tea's and coffee should be offered. Got a better service from Jetstar on a 1 hour flight flying to Sydney from Melbourne. Understand that companies need to make money back after COVID but don't take advantage of it as people will stop using the airline, like us we won't use ever again. Would rather pay extra and get better service and airline..
reviews.author: V S

reviews.title: Still in bankruptcy, no cash refunds
reviews.text: They cancelled the return flight. They would not provide a cash refund, only flight credits due to their ongoing bankruptcy. Due to the short notice, had to 2x spend more on the new return tickets (Singapore Air) than the original return ticket. Do not fly Air Asia X, the cost savings is not worth the risk.
reviews.author: No Cash

reviews.title: Cancelled flights on me, but never refunded
reviews.text: Cancelled flights during Covid, and therefore should refund the fees. Made me fill out a form, and never refunded. Couldn't be reached most of the time, but when they could they made false promises, and at the same time still sold tickets for the cancelled flights. Had to do a credit card recharge.
reviews.author: Edwin P

reviews.title: Worst airline ever
reviews.text: The worst airline ever, they had to shut down and now they have started again but with non refundable tickets. So pls do not fall for such frustrated mindsets. If business doesnot work shut it down but dont deprive passengers of their rights and make business from people who trust you but are cheated everytime. BE WARE OF THIS AIRLINE PEOPLE
reviews.author: Stella

reviews.title: Couldn't even book the flight I wanted - hopeless customer service
reviews.text: I have been trying all weekend to book a flight with this airline. The price is excellent, half the price of the nearest competitor. However, when I reach payment all the zero processing fee options, PayPal, POLi and Zip are not working. I haven't tried card payment because it adds a whopping $20 to the price. I have wrestled with their hideous ChatBot Ava - its useless. Eventually I managed to get a livechat and explained the problem. I was promised a response by email. Over 24 hours later, nothing! I can't get past the indomitable AVA for a second time. Save yourselves the heartbreak. The price is cheap but you can't actually book the flight.
reviews.author: Cygnetmama

reviews.title: No customer service
reviews.text: Due to the corona virus many flights were disrupted. When trying to contact air asia, there were no response from their call centre or their all stars (online team). This forced us to travel to one of their service centres. When we arrived we were advised that we had to travel to the airport for our enquires to be handled. Once at the airport the representive wouldn't give a reference number for the discussing that we had. Poor support service and I advise not to fly air asia or any of their subsidiaries.
reviews.author: Worldtravellerpp

reviews.title: You pay for what you get
reviews.text: This airline is just a classic budget airline. Chairs are not comfortable, with no moveable headrest. No complementary meals on board so make sure you order something beforehand. We flew for 9 hours so it was unavoidable that we needed food. Food is okay, is only $7 AUD each way. Snacks are available for purchase. The only water they provide is one tiny bottle which is absurd for a 9 hour flight. The chairs are hard and small, minimal legroom. However for the budget traveller it’s a good option.
reviews.author: Nikita

reviews.title: I got there
reviews.text: The aircraft was a new A330 NEO and being all the way to the front end in row 1, the cabin was quiet. We took off on time. Food was pre-ordered. The portion was a bit small. Maybe add 25% to that, would be good. Also it would be nice to have some more western selections and yeah I know it's Air Asia. We landed late because of low visibility but can't blame them for that.
reviews.author: Nopadol T

reviews.title: Inline Low cost poor service airline
reviews.text: Absolutely poor flight attendant. However still acceptable due to low cost poor service return. Great airliner anyway,fly if you like to save money.
reviews.author: Departure780891

reviews.title: Book a Hotseat
reviews.text: Flew with Air Asia to Bangkok. For the flight over we booked the two seaters at the back of the plane, row 50. It would have been a perfectly good flight except in the last row, row 51, was a very small and angry toddler that made our flight horrendous. Not the airlines fault at all, and only a negative reflection on the parents. On our flight back, as it was an overnight flight, we booked a Hotseat, row 7, with extra legroom. This was right at the front of the plane, and directly behind Business Class. I’d book in this row again as it was much, much more comfortable than up the back, much more quieter too. Only negative is the toilets are not as close. There’s no frills on these flights so bring your own entertainment, although you can hire an iPad. We also took our own food/snacks and drinks. Although I have prebooked meals on other flights, which were very tasty. I’d fly Air Asia again, but I’d use what I save in airfares time upgrade my seat, especially if it’s a long flight.
reviews.author: TnPeat&Travel

reviews.title: Class A of Budget Airlines
reviews.text: As far as budget airlines go, I love Air Asia and consider myself a huge investor for the long run! Hardly ever delayed, professional staff, attentive service, orderly boarding process, I also applaud Air Asia for having secured primary use of this old but amazing Mother of all airports, Don Muang. Topping it all, the price of the return ticket is hard to beat. Compliments for a job well done.
reviews.author: Meyung R

reviews.title: Danger!! Careful!! pay for your ticket but be refused boarding!!! mistake or Scam???
reviews.text: We were refused Boarding due to an Air Asia Ticketing Error. We attempted to contact Air Asia Customer Support to get it rectified. Despite being a Air Asia BIG Loyalty Program Member for more than 5 years we were unable to get it rectified. This was Air Asia's mistake but they deny liability. Repeated attempts to get Customer Support were useless. You cannot speak with anyone. Are forced to use Automated Response that is ineffective, confusing and frustrating. If you do manage to get to their "Allstars" chat program (communicating by texting ... not voice) then the staff are unhelpful, combative and sometimes rude. Come on Air Asia get your act together. Your Guest Details Booking Page needs to be updated to reflect current Ticketing Requirements, Your Customer Support Systems need a total overhaul and your support staff need to be educated that unless they take care of customers then they won't have a job. I am now wondering exactly how many other people have had this experience. It must be highly profitable to be paid money for flights and then not have to fly people. After 5 years of flying Air Asia I, and my entire family, are now having to warn people of this situation .... Shame Air Asia!!!
reviews.author: Thi Le

reviews.title: Narrow seats
reviews.text: I flew from Bangkok to Seoul with AirAsia X. By approaching the checkin desk the trainee was very helpful showing me where to go. When i was there, the lady behind the checkin desk was too busy on her phone to even notice me. I had booked a hot seat. Way up in front, a window seat. The area where i was seated was vorming into the cockpit, i could not sit normally without leaning into the other seat next to me. I changed my seat, and even that was terrible, the seating space is so narrow, extremely narrow, my behind and legs were stuck into the seat. I am a big guy, not small, but this was terrible. I switched seats twice, and got into a free row where i could put the armrest up. How can you do this, such a small airplane, and 3-3-3 formation? TERRIBLE. No complains about the stewardess on the airplane, extremely kind, a smile from ear to ear and helpful. But, AirAsia X..you got to solve this. Why not a 2-3-2 formation?
reviews.author: Jammy1983

reviews.title: Dreadful food, disinterested cabin staff
reviews.text: I fly Air Asia a lot but only recently on the new Thai Air Asia service direct to BKK. The planes are essentially the same but the food on this service was woeful. Three of us were flying & none of us could eat the boring rice & chicken on offer. There is a very limited selection when you book & none is appetising. This was a daytime flight but once the blankets & pillows were given out, nobody came past to see if everything was ok during the flight. I understand that this is a LLC but it's just good pr. They weren't run off their feet, especially in Premium Class. Other than that I generally find the crews to be friendly & helpful if a request is made of them. The seats are good. Much better than Scoot but you have to play around when booking. Some days are outrageously priced in Premium. Not sure how all that works. If you can be flexible & book reasonably far ahead, it's a good way to fly.
reviews.author: ladz

reviews.title: Easy ,simple flight
reviews.text: Unfortunately,flight was delayed out of Fukuoka,for more than 3 hrs due to late arrival of aircraft.I found out that the flight departed late from BKK as well.So after we arrived at Fukuoka airport at 6.15am (ETD 0745) were told the new departure time is 1055hrs!Wish there was a mailing system where they inform us earlier so that we could have left home later!(coz ,we took a taxi to the airport because of the early departure! The most I've paid for a cab in my 20yrs of life in Japan!)Well.it's LCC so no such service like full service arlines,perhaps.Anyways,appreciate the kindness of the airlines as they surprised us with a meal voucher to have breakfast at the airport.That appeased many,I'm sure.The flight to BKK was good,staff were kind and had friendly disposition. Return flight was on schedule fortunately.All in all,a great flight with good time schedule..just a little too early out of Fukuoka for us but it can't be helped.Thank you Air Asia! Looking forward to flying with you again.
reviews.author: Rchan18

reviews.title: Bad Service
reviews.text: Okay right on, during our flight the crew did not even bother asking if we needed to buy anything even though they saw that we took out some money out they just passed up and down but serve only the Thai people since we were probably the only Americans on that plane. The lady at the counter changed our sit to the “emergency Exit” which is great. Anyways we were left thirsty and hungry we love Thailand and love to to travel we will avoid flying from this airline at all cost.
reviews.author: Joanna L

reviews.title: No australian phone contact
reviews.text: I have booked flights to Penang and wanted to speak to someone about my seating which was charged for even though I booked a value pack which included fee seating choice. I tried to call the Australian phone number that I have used previously but it was always engaged. I went on line and did a live chat and got no satisfaction I kept being referred to links which did not answer my questions. They did however confirm that there is no longer a phone number that Australian passengers can call to speak to someone directly. They have closed their Australian sales phone centre.! So there is now no way you can talk to a human directly even though you might have booked on their web site for a big flight booking They told me to refer all questions through flight centre who are only able to contact air asia if you book through them. I think this is ridiculous. Even though I have booked with them many times before I will avoid booking with them again because of the lack of customer service.
reviews.author: JenandbrianPerthWA

reviews.title: Lowcost ที่เริศมากกกก
reviews.text: สวัสดีค่ะ ทริปนี้ เป็นทริปGO GO JAPAN เป็นทริป ที่ฉุกละหุกมากกก บิน 25 มิ.ย. กับ 29 มิ.ย. จองวันที่ 20 มิ.ย. จร้าาา ราคา 3 คนไป-กลับ พร้อมอาหาร และ น้ำหนัก (ขากลับ) 24,xxxบาท Flight XJ602 DMK-NRT เวลา 05:05 - 13:05 (โดยประมาณ) เคาท์เตอร์เช็คอิน เปิดประมาณ ตี2นิดๆ เช็คอินไม่มีอะไรมากกก 🧳น้ำหนักกระเป๋า ซื้อไว้เท่าไหร่ก็เตรียมมาเท่านั้นนะคะ เข้มงวดเรื่องนี้มากนะคะ แต่เราไม่มีโหลดใต้เครื่องในขาไป carry on ทั้งหมด ก็ต้องชั่งน้ำหนักเหมือนกันค่ะ เช็คอิน เรียบร้อย เข้า ตม.กันค่ะ ช่วงที่เข้าตม. ประมาณ ตี3นิดๆ ก็คนน้อยดี รวดเร็ว ตรวจสัมภาระ มี 3-4ช่อง ก็โฟลว ได้ดี เราก็แวะshopping king power นิสนุง🙈 Gate 15 ไกลเกือบสุด ใช้บริการ air asia X 3ครั้ง ไม่gate12ก็ 15 gateใหญ่ เพราะฉะนั้น จะเดินทางก็ต้องเช็คเวลาดีๆนะคะ แผื่อเวลา สัก30นาทีก่อนเวลาboarding ถึงgateแล้ว. ไฟลท์นี้ ผู้โดยสารไม่มากค่ะ ได้ขึ้นเครื่องเร็วดี 😊 โดยปกติถ้าคนเยอะ หน้าgate ที่นั่งจะไม่พอยืนรอ แออัดในระดับนึงเลย เครื่องที่จะพาเราไปแดนอาทิตย์อุทัย เป็น A330-300 จัดที่นั่ง 3-3-3 ลำนี้ไม่มี premium flat bed เราจองเป็น silence zoneมา ก็เลยได้นั่งส่วนหน้าของลำ😎😎😎 ความดีงาม ในการบินในครั้งนี้คือ silence zoneของเรานั้น คนไม่มากจะมีที่ ที่เราสามารถนอนได้ทั้งแถว😝 นึกในใจ หลับแซ่บล่ะบาดหนิ😁😁😁 พนักงานต้อนรับบนเครื่อง มืออาชีพนะคะ ไม่น้อยหน้า full service เขาเลยยยย บริการดี 10/10ค่ะ เครื่องtaxi. ก็มีการสาธิต กรณีมีเหตุฉุกเฉิน ตามมาตรฐาน ต้องดูนะคะ เครื่องบิน ลำใหญ่ take off นิ่มมากกกกก หลังเครื่องชึ้นได้สัก 15นาที ก็ปิดสัญญาณรัดเข็มขัด พนักงานต้อนรับบนเครื่อง ก็จะแจกใบคนเข้าเมืองของญี่ปุ่นให้คนละ2ใบ ตัวอย่าง วิธีการกรอก มีบอกในนิตรสารบนเครื่องค่ะ ที่อยู่หน้าที่นั่งเรา ลองเปิดไล่ๆหาดูนะคะ กรอกเสร็จ เราไม่สามารถจะฝืนตัวเองได้ ขอตัวนอนค่ะ ก็มีแถวที่นั่งว่างตรงไหนก็ เอนใส่เลย เนื่องด้วยบินด้วยสายการบินlow cost ไม่มีผ้าห่มบริการ ต้องเตรียมมานะคะ *หมอนรองคอสำคัญยิ่งนัก แต่air asia มีบริการ หมอน ผ้าห่ม ผ้าปิดตา ชุดละ 3xxบาทนะคะ ***ใครที่คิดว่าตัวเองจะเมาเครื่อง*** แนะนำนะคะ วิธีนี้ ใช้ได้ผล(สำหรับเรา)อย่างยิ่ง ก่อนขึ้นเครื่อง 30นาที ยาแก้เมารถ 1 เม็ด ขึ้นเครื่องปุ๊ป ยาลดน้ำมูก 1เม็ด แต่ถ้าใครเพิ่งกินข้าวมา ยาลดอาการอาเจียน 1เม็ด แล้วตลอดการบินของเราก็จะราบรื่น (เภสัชกร แนะนำมานะคะ ไม่ได้คิดเองนะ) ก่อนนอน ลูกเรือแจ้ง จะเสริฟอาหาร เวลา 10:00 ของเวลา ญี่ปุ่น (เวลาญี่ปุ่นเร็วกว่าเรา2ช้่วโมง) ตั้งนาฬิกาปลุก นอนจร้า กำลังจะนอน กัปตันก็ทักทาย เสียงหล่อมากแม่!!!! หน้าก็หล่อ!!! แม่!!!! ทำไมรู้???? พอดีเช็คอิน พร้อมกัน 🥰🥰🥰 เราก็ว่าเทสเราดีเด้อ งานดีpremium แน่นอน ต่อๆค่ะ ฮ่าๆ ทักทาย แจ้งชื่อ แซ่ ,เวลาเดินทาง,แจ้งว่าอาจมีสภาพอากาศแปรปรวนในเส้นทางที่บินผ่าน และแจ้งตำแหน่งล่าสุดที่เราผ่านและที่จะบินผ่าน ก็มีอุบลราชธานี,ลาว,เวียดนาม,ทะเลจีนใต้,ไต้หวันและเข้าญี่ปุ่นทางโอกินาวา ระหว่างการเดินทางเพื่อความปลอดภัยรัดเข็มขัดนะครับ กัปตัน กล่าว และมีภาษาอังกฤษ ต่อด้วยภาษาญี่ปุ่น เอ่าาาาา เริศจร้าาาสา แล้วก็หลับไป... รู้สึกตัวอีกทีประมาณ 6-7โมงเช้า ลูกเรือปลุก เครื่องturbulence จร้า นี่ก็ต้องงัดตัวเองขึ้นมา รัดเข็มขัด เครื่องก็โคลงเคลงไป ประมาณ 2นาที ก็กลับสู่ความปกติ นอนต่อค่ะ อีกประมาณ 1ชั่วโมงต่อมา turbulence อีกครั้ง กัปตัน,ลูกเรือ แจ้งผู้โดยสาร รัดเข็มขัด อยากให้มั่นใจในกัปตันนะคะ เก่งมาก เอาอยู่ และด้วยสมรรถนะของairbus a330 ให้ปฏิบัติตามลูกเรือบอกอย่างเคร่งครัด เพื่อความปลอดภัย 10โมง นาฬิกาปลุก ตรงกับลูกเรือกำลังเข็นรถเข็นบริการ อาหาร เครื่องดื่ม สำหรับเราสั่งซื้อมาพร้อมกับตอนจองตั๋ว ก็เตรียมบัตรโดยสารเพื่อแสดงกับลูกเรืออีกครั้งก่อน จะเสริฟอาหารนะคะ อาหารสำหรับเราว่าดีเลยนะ รสชาตคนไทยกิน รสอาจจะไม่จัดมาก กระเพรา,แกงเขียวหวาน ยืน1 ***บัตรเครดิตธนาคารกรุงเทพร่วมเอเชีย แลกเครื่องดื่มร้อน-เย็น ราคาไม่เกิน60บาท ได้ฟรีนะคะ*** ทานเสร็จเรียบร้อย ก็นอนอีกสักงีบ พอเครื่องเราเข้าน่าฟ้าของประเทศญี่ปุ่น กัปตันก็จะแจ้ง และให้เราเตรียมตัวค่ะ มองหาภูเขาไฟฟูจิ 🗻🗻🗻 (นั่งฝั่งซ้ายนะคะ) ด้วยฤดูร้อนเข้าฝน เมฆคือหนาและเยอะม๊ากกกก แต่ด้วยแต้มบุญที่พอมี ก็ได้เห็นยอดเขาโผล่ขึ้นมาต้อนรับเรา🗻 และอีก45นาที และก็จะlanding ที่สนามบินนาริตะ ลูกเรือก็เช็คความเรียบร้อย กันค่ะ แค่อึดใจเดียว landing นิ่มสุด นิ่มจริง มาชเมลโล่มาก เราก็มาถึงสนามบินนาริตะ ประเทศญี่ปุ่น โดยสวัสดิภาพ สำหรับAIR ASIA X เราพอใจมาก กับราคา บริการ ทั้งก่อน ระหว่าง และหลัง ยังคงเป็นสายการบินlow cost ที่ยืนหนึ่ง ในใจเรา❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️🗻🗻🗻❤️
reviews.author: KENTSUYA

reviews.title: I arrived alive .....that's what I wanted
reviews.text: We were in the very chaotic,sweaty confusing DMK Airport, Bangkok . Long lines of yelling Chinese people due to what I think was a cancelled flight to China. When we got to the desk of course the desk clerk started the Airasia scam where they insist you pay for your bags many times the cost or any airline in the world,to get around this just hide your bag in the angry mob at the desk I promise there will be one.. But its super cheap 217 US dollars 1 way Bangkok to Honolulu via Osaka If we would have paid for a bag...........try 70 US Dollars....
reviews.author: seamillfarmcom

reviews.title: The best low-cost airlines
reviews.text: We heard lots of negative feedback but Air Asia simply exceeded our expectation with new aircraft, timely departure and Delicious food. We will strongly recommend Air Asia
reviews.author: Rajib C

reviews.title: noisy staff disturb us
reviews.text: Noisy flight attendant talks all the time. Her loud voice disturbed our calmness. They sometimes cheered like having a party. Give me a break !! 四六時中大声で話す乗務員がいて静かな時間がなかった。たまに乗務員３-４人で大声を出し、盛り上がり、迷惑極まりない。一体何処だと思っているのか。勤務場所でなく、パーティ会場と思っているかの様な振舞だった。
reviews.author: yoshirinyoshi

reviews.title: Lee M
reviews.text: I thought I was getting a great deal until I got to the airport and was told I couldn’t carry the bag on and I would have to pay 3000 Baht to check my bag. This is a dysfunctional set up. you have to go to another area and pay and then come back to the same line to drop off bag. Crazy note: I could have booked another flight with a pre checked bag less than I had to pay for the bag? Read the fine print! Do not recommend this airline based on experience for the trip.

reviews.text: The airplane is small and old. And the cabin attendant are hard on passenger. Because some passengers are noisy and talk loudly. So it disturb another passengers so much.

reviews.title: Unfriendly staff and poor service
reviews.text: The staff were not friendly at all - when I asked for a blanket because I was cold they huffed and puffed about it, then made me pay for it and shoved it in my face.
reviews.author: tlj100172

reviews.title: AirAsia X exceeded our expectations
reviews.text: AirAsia X far exceeded our expectations. We were skeptical of flying a cut rate airline and read a lot of (good and bad) reviews prior to booking, but we couldn't turn down the bargain price, so we crossed our fingers, expected the worst but hoped for the best. The plane was a newer Airbus A330. Seats are not assigned in advance, nor could you check in online. The check in line was long but the process was easy once we got to the counter. The attendant was pleasant and our seats were assigned together. Note that they will weigh your bags so pack according to their specifications. We had pre-paid for 1 checked bag (about $30) but our carry ons were over the weight limit. Our options were to repack or pay an additional $123 to check a second bag. They were happy to give us the time to stuff some more things into our checked bag so we happily went off to find our the gate. The plane had comfortable reclining seats, and we actually were able to spread out as there were empty seats next to us. You need to bring your own entertainment, pillows, blankets, etc. The food is ala cart and on demand, but since we were on a red-eye we did not order food - there were many choices though and most dinners seemed to be around $16-20. The flight was smooth and although the lights were bright, I was able to sorta-sleep with an eye mask and earplugs for much of the 7 hour trip. The stewardesses were professional and very well dressed. We arrived 50 minutes early! Our bag was out by the time we got through customs and so we were pleased with the experience and would fly AirAsia X again.
reviews.author: morkandmindy

reviews.title: Ms
reviews.text: Had an 8 Hour flight Malaysia to sydney . Was itchy all the way . Reached home only to find bed bug bites all over my body.
reviews.author: Vacationer263347

reviews.title: Poor ground service operation in Chubu Centrair Nagoya Int'l  Airport
reviews.text: Terrible ground operation service in Nagoya. Unfortunate that my flight back from Nagoya to Bangkok was cancelled due to technical issue. It seems they do not have experience to handle flight cancellation properly. Meal voucher at 500 yen and accommodation are provided for all passengers at 21:30 hrs. Meal voucher do not mentioned anything and ask their " Station Manager Mr. Sasahara " where I can redeem this meal voucher. " Any shop in the airport " that 's an answer from Station Manager. Once I went to " SUBWAY " they rejected , I went down to " LAWSON " they rejected. it seems worthless as no one want to accept Air Asia meal voucher. Station manager claimed that everyone happy, and only me had an issue. Finally half of passengers on that flight could not redeem that voucher. ( Quite a bit look down on me that I'm only one who 's not happy with this voucher ) Finally it's a miscommunication between Air asia ground operation and " SUBWAY "
reviews.author: Prachai L

reviews.title: Low cost flight to thailand
reviews.text: We had seats allocated to us via web checkin in different rows and even though customer service through facebook wouldn't change them, the girl at the checkin counter did. It was a large plane with enough empty seats that a lot of passengers moved to empty seats. My husband is 6' 2" and just had enough room for his knees but that is always the case. Being budget flights, all extras like meals and check in bags are charged for. the take off and landing wernt smoothly and whenever there was turbulence, the Captain would always announce what was happening. About 8 cabin crew on the flight so everyone was attended to quickly.
reviews.author: SuzeBrisbane

reviews.title: Budget prices budget experience
reviews.text: One day before my outward flight I received an email notification that my flight had been cancelled. I checked on SkyScanner and sure enough the flight no longer shows in the schedule. I was given the one option of taking the next flight some 4 hours later. What choice did I have? This meant my onward flight connection at KL to DMK would be missed. A phone call to them cleared that up and they would put me on a later flight for that leg too. Shame they couldn't have told me all of this in the same email. No explanation for the flight cancellation. A Google search showed that this happens every now and then with AirAsia. I've been flying a few times a year for the last 30 years and have never had a flight cancel on me until this one. Budget flights are cheap(er) but you do miss out on some essentials like being to request the seat of your choice (I don't like being hemmed in so an aisle is my preference), online check-in so I don't need to arrive at the airport 2 hours before departure, free water and something to eat on the flight, in-flight entertainment and flight crew who answer to the courtesy button calls. The fiasco at the gate is no better with seating divided into zones from 1 to 3/4. Zone 1 at the head of the plane is boarded first though surely boarding the rear passengers (after 1st class etc) first would be more efficient. After the zone 1 announcement but whilst the zone 1 passengers are still boarding from the lounge all other passengers are allowed to board and it just becomes a mess. This may be the last time I fly AirAsia as I started using them 6 years ago and enough is enough.
reviews.author: Nelson C

reviews.title: Comfortable and Reliable Flight which arrived on time.
reviews.text: I took Premium Flat Bed seat on Thai Air Asia X to KIK Osaka recently, and I was happy with their service and had comfortable flight which arrived on time despite the strong typhoon and airport closure just a few hours before landing.

reviews.title: flight from hell
reviews.text: First time i have flown air asia x on international route . Tried to save money to stay at the Hilton hotel.First flight was from Chiang Rai to Bangkok. My knees were pressed against the the seat in front of me, absolutely no room at all.The meal was a cheap rice and chicken that tasted like it was months old . The international flight was just as bad . small seats and bad service .And......there was no entertainment units at all .I have never seen this before in a international flight . On the way back I wanted to up grade to business class and the cost was an extra $700 for both of us . I was going to pay it when I asked do they have better food and entertainment on business class , the ticket man said no just wider seats ...so we changed to a exit seat at a small charge . The food was just the same as in domestic flights . Pleas if you can do not use this airline ,.
reviews.author: kevinpatrickbarker

reviews.title: Gas mask needed! Or something to cover your nose and mouth
reviews.text: What the hell!? This is the first time in my life to have stewardess walking through the aisles spraying aerosols to kill potential bugs. OMyGosh! The warning to cover your moth and nose didn’t come until they had already it. People were couching, babies started crying. You could see the spray in the air as well. Really not a nice experience at all. Food was ok. To a credit some of the staff is nice. I asked for a pen and the woman avoided me for the rest of the flight. I pushed the bell again and another passenger gave me his pen. In total I was ignored, partially gassed out and served so-so food.
reviews.author: YaminahFly

reviews.title: Cheap - pretty much like Jetstar - basic service cheap fares
reviews.text: All okay - basic airline with cheap fares, get you there no fuss. I am a FF and this is just a base service, no food or anything, we were down the back and when you hit turbulence, better up front of the aircraft..
reviews.author: Richard M

reviews.title: Poor customer service, triple charged baggage, would not refund!!!
reviews.text: Very disappointed with Air Asia as a frequent flyer after last experience. Online check-in had errors and glitches which did not allow me to checkin early, charged 40,000 yen at airport. Showed pictures of website glitches and errors, airline does not care or understand. Then I was accidentally tripled charged on my return flight baggage. Had 5 transactions for baggage totaling over $800 USD! My two tickets cost only around $700. Was refunded for some of the excess charges, however such a hassle and online help and calling is very time consuming and stressful and not user friendly. I figured if I provided pictures and explained my problems the airline would understand the online checkin and website had experienced problems and was not working properly. Poor customer service using live chat and submitting cases on issues, just replied back with automated answers. Like talking to a computer. Nobody should have to get charged over $800 USD and worry about 5 charges for 2 small check-in bags, especially unauthorized charges. Very disappointed and will never fly again because of airlines poor recognition of the problem, poor customer service and failure to refund a small cost that should never of happened. Nobody should have to go through that stress while on vacation!
reviews.author: Rebeca M

reviews.title: Pretty Okay for long flight
reviews.text: I was asleep for the whole flight ... but they ran out of food ... and was an okay flight .. long one though...
reviews.author: Princess Leia

reviews.title: Cheap Bangkok to Tokyo
reviews.text: Picked up a super cheap ticket to fly from DMK to Tokyo and following a delay from Bali DPS we got a meal voucher and extra leg room seats. The flight was very empty so we were also able to take advantage of more seats to be able to sleep comfortably by making our own economy flatbed. Don't expect any service, drinks, food, blankets ect even on a long haul flight but if it saves you loads of money then we feel air Asia is worth it but we always price check first to see if we can pick up a full service airline especially if you are checking in luggage. Anyway once we were on and settled down we took two sleeping tablets and the next thing we knew we were in Japan.
reviews.author: ed_mart_adventures

reviews.title: Catastrophic experience.
reviews.text: Australia became my 91st country. Dozens of airline companies from all over the world. Air Aisa has become the worst. Absolutely. Airline is a real disaster. Of course, not in the sense like for the dead passengers of that flight from the Indonesian Surabaya, where relatives are suing the brainchild of Mr. Fernandez so far. We survived, but Air Asia ruined our vacation, ruined our plans, and we lost a lot of money. We are traveling with my wife and daughter. The wife was supposed to fly from Sydney via Kuala Lumpur to Delhi by Air Asia X. Further to Moscow by Aeroflot. Transit through the transit zone. One terminal with Aeroflot. However, the employee did not put, arguing the need for a visa. None of the arguments were not accepted. There is no one to complain at Sydney airport. We had to cancel the trip with my daughter and fly with my wife, buying tickets for this bad Air Asia. The greed of the company is such that they forced to buy a ticket for my wife on the Sydney - Kuala Lumpur segment, although it was included in her ticket. Why? No answer. Pettiness and greed of Asia Air has reached the point that they even canceled the ordered food. Just for 10-12 USD. Remember the billionaire Paul Getty, who installed in his estate paid call machine for guests, collecting 2 cents per call. The flight attendants refused even a request to bring a glass of water for our 8-year-old daughter, demanding to pay for it. And all this with smiles. False. And with glass eyes. Rare goons. The results of our last flight to the brainchild of the smiling Mr. Tony Fernandez. We lost 2 tickets (non-refundable) on the route Sydney-Brisbane-Cairns-Bali-Singapore-Athens. My wife lost tickets on the route Sydney-Kuala Lumpur-Delhi-Moscow-Murmansk. If You want something like this, fly Air Asia. If Air Asia will be in the chain of flights, this chain will collapse like a Domino when you push one. One last thing. As a doctor of philosophy, I'm used to looking for an unknown pattern in randomness, as Spinoza taught. I think that the disaster of December 28, 2014 in the Javanese sea with the A320 was not accidental. Saving on everything, pathological greed, employees without self-esteem leads ultimately to indifference to people, replaced by formal politeness and smiles like robots. Ultimately, it ends in disaster.
reviews.author: Vadim

reviews.title: Not impressed at all.
reviews.text: Everything about Air Asia is bad. Checking staff are rude, air cabin crew are rude and think they are better than everyone else, seating is extremely small, you have to pay for anything and everything. When you book online it usually gives you back an incorrect ticket which you then have to pay to change. Even booking at the counter they often get it wrong and you have to pay to change your flight. One of THE WORST airlines I've ever dealt with. Would NEVER recommend it to anyone.

reviews.title: Holidays
reviews.text: The best service. Flight was on time. Staff were great right from the airport. The only thing flying at night, you need to have warm clothes otherwise you rent a blanket. You even buy water. Everything you buy. That's why the ticket is so cheap.
reviews.author: Nomie22

reviews.title: Functional
reviews.text: I have flown on Air Asia several times via KL to various destinations. My experience has been that they are generally on time on thereabouts. I generally add the check-in baggage option and strongly recommend the Quite Zone for long haul over night flights. My check-in experiences have been okay and the staff have generally been friendly and helpful. IMO, negatives are split seating when you book together with another passenger, in-flight food and drink service is very slow, failure to dim the lights on late night flights and too many announcements and interruptions. Perhaps it's a case of you get what you pay for ;-)

Wonder if Air Asia plane leaving Don Muang could be on time for once?
